title: team-chat
subHeroTitle: Talk to your team where the work actually lives.
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ brings team messaging into your workspace so conversations stay connected to the tasks, projects, and decisions they're about.

sections.title: Channels for the whole team, messages for one-on-one
sections.desc: Create group channels for your teams and projects, or send a direct message to a colleague. All conversations are scoped to your company — nothing leaks out.

gridItems.title: Direct messages
gridItems.desc: Reach any teammate with a private, one-on-one message — no noise, no group clutter.

gridItems.title: Group channels
gridItems.desc: Set up channels for teams, projects, or topics. Public for the whole company, private for just the right people.

gridItems.title: Threaded replies
gridItems.desc: Reply directly to any message to keep conversations organized. No more losing important context in a wall of chat.

gridItems.title: File sharing
gridItems.desc: Drop files, images, or documents straight into a conversation. They're stored securely and always accessible.

sections.title: Messages that arrive instantly, every time
sections.desc: Team Chat delivers messages the moment they're sent — no refreshing, no delays. Typing indicators and unread counts mean you always know what needs your attention.

gridItems.title: Instant message delivery
gridItems.desc: Messages arrive the moment they're sent. No lag, no refresh — your team stays in real time, always.

gridItems.title: Typing indicators
gridItems.desc: See when someone is writing back so you're not left wondering if your message landed.

gridItems.title: Unread message counts
gridItems.desc: Every channel shows exactly how many unread messages are waiting. Nothing slips through the cracks.

gridItems.title: Channel management
gridItems.desc: Add or remove members, rename a group, or set up a new channel in seconds. You're in control.

capabilitiesDesc: KeilHQ brings communication directly into your workspace — so discussions stay connected to the work they're about.
checklistTitle: Keep your team aligned without the noise
checklistDesc: Stop chasing updates in separate chat apps. KeilHQ puts your team conversations right next to the work.
checklistItems: Set up channels for each team or project so conversations stay relevant and easy to find.
Send a direct message to any colleague — private, immediate, and within your workspace.
Reply to specific messages in threads so discussions stay organized, no matter how busy the channel gets.
Drop any file directly into a conversation. It's stored securely and accessible to everyone in the channel.
Messages arrive instantly — no refreshing or delays — so your team always stays in sync.
